# Calendar

```tsx
import { Calendar, CalendarButton, CalendarDayButton } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Lets users pick a day, a month, a year or a range of days. Mirrors the Figma Date Picker panel: Property 1 = Day / Month / Year, plus Range. It isn't a floating element, so it has no border or shadow; the Date Picker adds them around it.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<CalendarButton className="w-10" {...args} />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Date Picker panel: Property 1 = Day / Month / Year / Range. Day is the DayPicker grid; its caption button opens Month, whose caption opens Year. Range (mode="range", two months) has a plain caption and its own arrows on each month, as in Figma. The panel surface (border, radius, shadow) comes from the Popover, so the Calendar stays flat.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`CalendarButton`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active?` | `boolean` | State=Active: the selected day, month or year. |
| `today?` | `boolean` | Today: the 6px dot under the label. |

`CalendarHeader`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onPrevious?` | `() => void` | Leave undefined to disable the arrow. |
| `onCaptionClick?` | `() => void` | Turns the caption into the Button Month Year that switches views. |

`CalendarBaseProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `locale?` | `Locale` | date-fns locale for the captions, week days and labels. |
| `type?` | `CalendarView` | Figma Property 1: Day, Month or Year, the grid it opens on and what is picked. Month and Year can't go down to days and report the pick through `onPeriodSelect`. The caption still moves up to Month / Year. |
| `onPeriodSelect?` | `(date: Date) => void` | The month or year picked when `type` is "month" or "year". |
| `disabledDays?` | `Matcher \| Matcher[]` | Days whose Calendar Button is disabled, like past dates or weekends. |
| `mobile?` | `boolean` | Layout for the Bottom Sheet: fills its container with no padding of its own, and Range shows one month with the Month / Year caption. |

## Types

`CalendarProps`, `CalendarView`

## Rules

- Import `Calendar` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
